videoInstructionParagraph1.part1: To register an electronic account for the applicant, you need to go to the

The system will automatically check the uniqueness of the login, and if one already exists, you need to specify a different email address. It is important to use only mail services allowed in Ukraine, since addresses on mail.ru and yandex.ru are not accepted.

studentsCabinet.videoInstructionParagraph2: After entering your email address, you will receive an email with a link to activate your account. You must click on this link to confirm your registration.
studentsCabinet.videoInstructionParagraph3: The next step is to fill out the registration form. The applicant must provide the data of the external assessment certificate or NMT: number, pin code and year of receipt. If the applicant has several external assessment certificates, only one of them is used for registration, and the others can be added after registration is completed. It is also necessary to enter information from the certificate of complete general secondary education: series and document number.
studentsCabinet.videoInstructionParagraph4: Registration for an electronic account is possible only for holders of certificates issued no earlier than 1998. If the certificate was issued before this year, you can only submit an application in paper form directly at the educational institution.
studentsCabinet.videoInstructionParagraph5: If the applicant does not have an external examination or NMT certificate, he or she can check the box "I do not have NMT certificates (external examination)" and complete the registration using only an identity document.

publicDiscussionOfPrograms.pageHeader: Public discussion of educational program projects
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.publicDiscussionParagraph1: We invite employers, graduates, applicants, and scientific and pedagogical workers to a public discussion of the projects of the Educational Programs of the National Research Institute of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, the recruitment for which will take place in the 2025-26 academic year!
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.publicDiscussionParagraph2: From February 6 to March 6, 2026, we invite you to familiarize yourself with the draft educational programs for public discussion at the link
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.publicDiscussionParagraph3: Please send suggestions and comments on educational and professional programs to the e-mail address of the Scientific and Research Institute of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForStakeholdersDescription: We have initiated strategic monitoring to ensure that the knowledge and skills we provide fully meet the needs of the IT industry.
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForGraduates: Questionnaire for graduates of the Institute of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (Faculty of Computer Science)
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForGraduatesDescription: Share your professional experience so that we can make education for new students as relevant and useful as possible.
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForStudents: Questionnaire for students of the Educational and Research Institute of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForStudentsDescription: Your voice changes education! We are conducting quality monitoring: evaluate teachers, the relevance of subjects, and the organization of the process.
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForPhDStudentsDescription: We have initiated strategic quality monitoring of our educational programs and IT specialist training. Our goal is to ensure not only the relevance of the curricula, but also a high level of scientific and research component.
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForEmployersAboutQuality: Questionnaire for employers regarding the quality of Karazin University's educational and professional programs
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForEmployersAboutQualityDes: Karazin University continues to operate during the war and strives to improve the quality of its graduates' education. The Institute of Public Administration is conducting a survey of employers regarding the quality of educational programs offered to students at Karazin University. Your participation in the survey is completely confidential. The data obtained will only be used in aggregate form.
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForStudentsAboutQuality: Questionnaire for Karazin University students on the quality of the educational program
publicDiscussionOfPrograms.questionnaireForStudentsAboutQualityDesc: Karazin University continues to work and make efforts to improve the quality of training of its graduates in the conditions of war. The Institute of Public Administration is conducting a survey of our university's students regarding the quality of the educational programs they are enrolled in. Your participation in the survey is completely confidential. The data obtained will only be used in aggregate form.

admissionRepository.introText: Here you can find all educational and scientific programs (ESP), entrance exam programs, and curricula of the Institute for various levels of education. Select the level (Bachelor, Master, or Postgraduate), then the specialty, and finally the academic year to download the required document.
